comparison.objective: Fit a hose over a barb and secure it with a clamp; candidate tunes an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and push a hose onto a barb, position a clamp, and tighten it versus release and reacquire a moving setscrew socket around fine collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Hose fully seated and clamp correctly located and tightened versus repeatable non-bottoming impact stops within force and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Fastener tightening is only a shared primitive; hose assembly does not test response-based damper tuning.
